meta.title: Gameplan fixtures — deck judgments from the 2026-09-28 deck-analysis chat
meta.source: Will's chat export (mtg_chat_export.txt): Vraska, Jyoti, Bumbleflower, Vren, Helga, Thranduil
meta.status: spec — assertions pass as the gameplan model lands (scripts/semantics-gameplan-fixtures.js reports progress)

assertion_kinds.plan: the engine chain the model must infer for the deck (engine, fuel, output, converters)
assertion_kinds.link: which chain link a card fills in this deck (fuel | amplifier | converter | protection | enabler | foundation), optionally also_fuel when a foundation card also feeds the engine
assertion_kinds.prefer: within one slot, `better` must outrank `worse` for this deck. Either card may be outside the deck (then it is scored as an add candidate against the in-deck one — e.g. Counterspell vs the deck's Dazzling Denial)
assertion_kinds.anti_plan: the card must carry an anti-plan signal with this reason code
assertion_kinds.rider: a card's conditional rider must be scored with this reliability for this deck
assertion_kinds.bottleneck: the thinnest chain link the model must report for this deck
assertion_kinds.coverage: how many cards count toward a plan-critical piece, and which do NOT count
assertion_kinds.cuts_include / cuts_exclude: the suggested-cuts list (top N) must / must not contain these
assertion_kinds.adds_include_any: at least K of these must appear in the suggested adds (top N)
assertion_kinds.direction: the plan's direction — what the engine's output is spent on (go-wide drain, vehicles, counters/voltron, group hug …) — top pick, optionally a named runner-up
assertion_kinds.not_anti_plan: the card must NOT carry any anti-plan signal in this deck (symmetric gifts in a group-hug deck, vehicles in a noncreature-spell engine)
assertion_kinds.cuts_include_any: at least `min` of these must appear in the suggested cuts
assertion_kinds.adds_exclude: none of these may appear in the suggested adds
assertion_kinds.adds_links: at least `min` of the top `top` suggested adds carry one of these plan links (property check — the principle, not a card list)

reason_codes.no_fuel: casting it does not satisfy the commander's trigger filter, in a deck where that is the plan's fuel (e.g. a creature in a noncreature-spell engine)
reason_codes.copy_not_cast: its value is copies of spells, and copies are not cast (CR 707.10) — cast-trigger engines ignore them
reason_codes.symmetric_benefit: the effect helps every player; in a deck racing its opponents that is a net loss
reason_codes.legendary_copy: copies the legendary commander, so the legend rule keeps only one — ETB value only
reason_codes.redundant_with_engine: does something the engine's output already does
reason_codes.off_color_cost_reducer: reduces costs of a color the plan's key cards are not
reason_codes.narrow: only works in a narrow situation (soft counter with a small tax, conditional redirect)
reason_codes.tapped_mana: mana source that enters tapped, in a deck where tempo matters more than the fixing
reason_codes.no_engine_target: blink/flicker with nothing in the plan to re-trigger

confidence.high: clear call in the chat, card text verified there
confidence.medium: reasoned in the chat but a judgment call — treat as a soft target

meta.user_overrides_note: Where Will disagreed with the chat, Will's position is the expected behavior (user_override: true).
meta.generalization: Assertions are written against specific decks, but each one tests a GENERAL rule named in its `principle` field (see `principles`). Three mechanisms keep them from being deck-specific: (1) principles — the model implements the rule, never the card; (2) paired decks — the same commander or the same cards in two directions must produce OPPOSITE verdicts (vraska-v2 vs vraska-vehicles, bumbleflower vs bumbleflower-hug); (3) invariants — property checks the runner applies to EVERY deck it can load, including engine2/fixtures/decks and pulled decks, not just these.

preferences.note: Standing preferences from the chat. These are SLIDER values (category targets + price), not engine opinions; the model must respect them and never override them.
preferences.removal_density: deliberately varies by deck (Helga low on purpose; Vren high)

principles.P-ENGINE: The plan is the engine's chain — fuel, output, direction — inferred from the engine's own abilities plus the 99's evidence.
principles.P-DIRECTION: Same engine, different direction: what the output is spent on is chosen by the deck, and it changes which cards are best.
principles.P-DUAL: A foundation card that also feeds the engine beats an equal one that doesn't (Signets in Vraska, removal in Vren).
principles.P-FUEL: Whether casting a card feeds the engine is a property of the card in this deck, tested against the engine's trigger filter.
principles.P-RIDER: A conditional rider is worth its value times the probability its condition is met; the commander meeting it makes it certain.
principles.P-SLOT: Within a job, roleStrength decides by default; plan fit decides when it outweighs the strength gap.
principles.P-ANTI: Anti-plan signals are tested per plan: the same effect can be anti-plan in one direction and on-plan in another.
principles.P-BOTTLENECK: Adds target the plan's thinnest link.
principles.P-COVERAGE: Plan-critical pieces count only if they cover the plan's actual case (mass vs single haste; return-on-death vs indestructible vs −X/−X).
principles.P-OVERRIDE: The user's stated choices are plan features, not errors (Vren's wipes + returns, Helga's protection, 37 lands, ~3 wipes).

invariants.rule: For an engine whose fuel is cast_spell filtered to noncreature, no creature card is marked also_fuel, and every noncreature spell passes the fuel test.
For an engine whose fuel is cast_spell with an mv_cmp filter, the fuel test agrees with each card's mana value (and {X} costs, when the filter allows them).
copy_not_cast fires only when the engine's fuel is cast_spell; never in other plans.
symmetric_benefit is anti-plan unless the plan direction is group-hug.
A rider conditioned on controlling type T has reliability 1 whenever the commander has type T.
legendary_copy fires only when the copy target is a legendary engine and no legend-rule breaker (Mirror Box, Sakashima class) is in the deck.
When the fuel is opponents' creatures leaving (Vren class), every single-target creature removal in the deck is also_fuel.
Suggested cuts never take a foundation category below its slider target, and never take a plan-critical piece below its coverage target.
Every suggested add names the slot it fills and at least one plan or foundation reason in English (no axis tokens).
Two decks with the same engine card infer the same fuel and output; only direction, converters and bottleneck may differ.
